versions.subject: Update lnx_clear_logs.yml
versions.detection:
selection1:
  - ProcessName|endswith: 
    - '/rm'
    - 'shred'
    - 'echo'
    - 'rmdir'
selection2:
    CommandLine|contains: 
      - '/var/log'
      - '/private/var/audit'
      - '/private/var/log/'
condition: selection1 and selection2

versions.subject: Update lnx_clear_logs.yml

selection:
    ProcessName|endswith:
        - '/rm'    # covers /rmdir as well
        - '/shred'
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '/var/log'
        - '/var/spool/mail'
condition: selection
